initial_user_message:
USER REQUEST
Can you suggest some books written by Daphne Brooks that are related to music?

mixtral:8x7b.title: Grace
mixtral:8x7b.explanation: A captivating exploration of the intersection of music and identity by Daphne Brooks, delving into themes of grace, resilience, and the transformative power of sound. This book offers a profound reflection on how music shapes our experiences and connections.

mixtral:8x7b.title: Bodies in Dissent: Spectacular Performances of Race and Freedom, 1850-1910
mixtral:8x7b.explanation: Analyzes the role of black performance culture in shaping American identity.

mixtral:8x7b.title: Subterranean Blues: Black Women and Sound Subcultures
mixtral:8x7b.explanation: Examines how African American women have used sound cultures to resist oppression.

gemma2:9b.title: Jazz Bravura: Performance, Politics, and Social Change
gemma2:9b.explanation: Explores the intersection of jazz music and social activism in 20th-century America.

gemma2:9b.title: Our Nig: Nina's Story from Slavery to Freedom
gemma2:9b.explanation: Analyzes a poignant narrative about Black life through the lens of musical traditions.

gemma2:9b.title: The Sound of Liberation: African American Music and the Global Struggle for Equality
gemma2:9b.explanation: Traces the evolution of African American music as a powerful force for social justice worldwide.

turns.user_response: I'll go with Grace and Subterranean Blues: Black Women and Sound Subcultures.
